scope: Independent visual/UX review of supplied synthetic Chromium PNGs only

nonblockingSuggestions.finding: Request fulfillment requires manual return after adding a video. Consider a contextual return-to-request action or linked fulfillment.
Library error says try again but offers Choose profile. A direct Retry control would reduce child recovery friction.
At portrait width, optional PIN labels wrap and the paired inputs do not quite align. Stack labels/fields or normalize label height.

independence: No peer reports, votes, repair history, Builder rationale or agent status/messages read before this verdict freeze. No source inspection, edits, rendering, deployment or peer consultation performed.
limitations: Synthetic API and SVG artwork; not deployed/authenticated family evidence
Not physical iPad/Safari and not genuine YouTube playback
Thumbnails/preview content do not certify current production artwork quality
Still images cannot establish action behavior, keyboard/screen-reader behavior, measured contrast, real network recovery or touch ergonomics.
50 PNGs actually opened; all 28 manifest inventories read for selection. Unopened captures are not certified.
Two tall full-document phone preview captures were read for their top modal; long background documents were skimmed rather than exhaustively read.
